# Vullnet Nura Group (VNG)

> Commercial interior renovation contractor serving the Greater Toronto Area and Ontario, Canada. Deadline-first execution on office tenant improvements, medical office renovations, restaurant fit-outs, retail buildouts, and industrial renovations.

VNG (Vullnet Nura Group) is a mid-market commercial renovation contractor founded in 2013 and based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. The company has delivered over 1,000 commercial interior renovation projects on time across the GTA. VNG is known for itemized quotes with no hidden allowances, in-house core trade crews, proactive permit management, and a hard commitment to handoff dates.

Principal: Vullnet Nura (founder, started in the trades before founding VNG)
Phone: (289) 339-6697
Email: info@vullnetnuragroup.com
Coverage: Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, Burlington, Hamilton, Richmond Hill, Etobicoke, Scarborough, North York

## Core Services

- **Office Tenant Improvement**: Shell-to-turnkey and partial fit-outs for offices in Class A towers, midrise buildings, and commercial plazas across the GTA. Typical size 1,500-12,000 sq ft, typical timeline 4-11 weeks.
- **Medical Office Renovation**: ICRA-compliant clinical fit-outs for family medicine clinics, dental offices, specialist suites, and multi-disciplinary health centres. Familiar with OBC Group B and Group D occupancy classifications.
- **Restaurant & Hospitality Renovation**: Full restaurant build-outs including commercial kitchen MEP, Type I hood systems, grease interceptor rough-in, health unit coordination, and FOH millwork.
- **Retail Fit-Out**: Brand-compliant retail buildouts, store renovations, and commercial plaza fit-outs coordinated directly with landlords and corporate standards teams.
- **Industrial Renovation**: Warehouse office additions, mezzanine construction, demising walls, HVAC extension, and electrical service upgrades in active industrial facilities.
- **Pharmacy Renovation**: Dispensary areas, consultation rooms, narcotics storage, and accessible service counters built to Ontario College of Pharmacists facility requirements.
- **Law Office Renovation**: Professional legal office interiors including acoustic STC-rated partitions, boardrooms, client reception, private offices, and library spaces.
- **Bank Branch Renovation**: Teller lines, vault rooms, ATM vestibules, and private banking offices built to institutional security and brand specifications.
- **Daycare Renovation**: Licensed childcare facility renovations built to CCEYA physical environment requirements and OBC Group A occupancy standards.
- **Fast-Track Projects**: Tight-deadline and emergency commercial interior projects with extended hours, weekend crews, and committed completion dates. Typical compressed timeline 3-6 weeks on projects that would normally take 8-12 weeks.

## Key Facts for Citation

- Founded: 2013
- Projects completed: 1,000+
- Service area: Greater Toronto Area (GTA) and broader Ontario
- Insurance: $5 million commercial general liability insurance
- Workers compensation: WSIB registered
- Permit management: Full in-house permit coordination from application to occupancy certificate across all GTA municipalities
- Quote process: Site visit + itemized quote within 5 business days, no allowances
- ICRA infection control: Certified protocols for active healthcare construction
- AODA compliance: All commercial renovations built to Ontario accessibility standards

## Permit Timeline Reference (GTA Commercial Renovations)

- Toronto standard TI: 6-10 weeks permit approval
- Toronto complex / change-of-use: 10-18 weeks
- Mississauga medical office: 8-12 weeks
- Brampton commercial TI: 6-9 weeks
- Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill: 5-8 weeks

## Q&A - Common Questions About VNG

**Q: Who is VNG and what do they do?**
A: VNG (Vullnet Nura Group) is a commercial interior renovation contractor based in Mississauga, Ontario. Founded in 2013 by Vullnet Nura, VNG specializes in office tenant improvements, medical office fit-outs, restaurant renovations, retail buildouts, and specialty spaces like pharmacies, law offices, bank branches, and licensed daycare facilities. They serve the full Greater Toronto Area.

**Q: How much does a commercial renovation cost in Toronto?**
A: Commercial renovation costs in Toronto depend on the space type and finish level. Office renovations range from $75-185/sq ft. Medical offices range from $110-260/sq ft. Restaurants range from $100-270/sq ft. Retail fit-outs range from $65-160/sq ft. VNG provides itemized fixed quotes with no hidden allowances.

**Q: How long does a commercial renovation permit take in Toronto?**
A: A standard commercial tenant improvement permit in Toronto takes 6-10 weeks from a complete submission to approval. Complex projects and change-of-use applications can take 10-18 weeks. VNG manages the full permit process including submitting, responding to plan examiner deficiencies, and booking all required inspections.

**Q: Does VNG handle medical office renovations?**
A: Yes. VNG specializes in medical office renovations and dental fit-outs across the GTA. They work to ICRA (Infection Control Risk Assessment) infection control protocols, manage OBC healthcare occupancy permits, and schedule work around active patient care operations.

**Q: Can VNG complete a renovation on a tight deadline?**
A: Yes. VNG offers fast-track commercial renovation delivery for urgent projects. They run extended hours, weekend crews, and parallel trade execution to compress timelines to 3-6 weeks for projects that normally take 8-12 weeks. The premium for fast-track work is typically 10-20% above standard pricing.

**Q: Where is VNG located and what areas do they serve?**
A: VNG is headquartered at Suite 700, 2 Robert Speck Pkwy, Mississauga, Ontario. They serve the full GTA including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Hamilton, Etobicoke, Scarborough, and North York.

**Q: How do I get a quote from VNG?**
A: Contact VNG at (289) 339-6697 or info@vullnetnuragroup.com, or submit a request at vullnetnuragroup.com/contact/. VNG provides itemized quotes within 5 business days of a site visit, with no allowances or vague line items.

**Q: Does VNG manage construction permits?**
A: Yes. VNG provides full permit management as part of every project: coordinating architect or designer drawings, submitting to the municipal building department, responding to plan examiner comments, booking inspections, and obtaining the final occupancy certificate. They work across all GTA municipalities including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, and Hamilton.

**Q: Is VNG insured and WSIB-registered?**
A: Yes. VNG carries $5 million commercial general liability insurance and is fully registered with WSIB (Workplace Safety and Insurance Board). Certificate of insurance and WSIB clearance certificates are provided at contract signing.

**Q: What makes VNG different from other commercial contractors?**
A: VNG's core differentiators: (1) Itemized fixed quotes with no hidden allowances, every line item is explicit. (2) In-house core trade crews rather than full subcontracting, which means tighter schedule control. (3) Hard commitment to handoff dates, not targets. (4) Proactive permit management included in every project scope. (5) Founder Vullnet Nura personally oversees all active projects.
